dimensions.assessment: Affects federal land management agencies, the National Telecommunications and Information Administration, and telecommunications entities requesting facility authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: the head of each Federal land management agency... ensure that each Federal land management agency... prioritizes the review of requests

dimensions.assessment: Establishes administrative oversight, periodic meetings, and reporting requirements to expedite review processes without altering underlying environmental or leasing laws.
dimensions.evidence: establishing objective and reasonable goals for the review of requests for communications use authorizations

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations, spending, or revenue changes are specified in the source text.
Creates a temporary or ongoing interagency coordination structure across specific departments and organizational field units.
dimensions.evidence: establish an interagency strike force to ensure that each Federal land management agency... prioritizes the review

dimensions.assessment: Requires initial actions and a report within specific short-term windows (180 to 270 days), establishing ongoing coordination duties for agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Assistant Secretary shall submit... a report

missing_information: Operational budget or staffing allocations for the strike force
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes an interagency strike force led by the Assistant Secretary of Commerce to prioritize, monitor, and set goals for federal land management agencies reviewing communications use authorizations on public and forest lands.
